{{Quote|The Jrade Plaza surrounding the newly commissioned marcluro-stone statue has in the past held tens of thousands of spectators, but today's sparse gathering was dominated instead by the presence of clone troopers and Senate Guard security.|A [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report on the opening of the Finis Valorum Memorial|<ref name="Insider" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:13]]" places the unveiling of the marcluro-stone [[Finis Valorum Memorial]] in 15:01:13, which corresponds to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> '''marcluro-stone''' was used in the construction of the [[Finis Valorum Memorial]], a statue built to honor the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]] in a [[Terrorist attack of 14:9:19|terrorist attack]]. The memorial was built in the [[Chancellery Walkway]] in [[Jrade Plaza]] in the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] on<ref name="Insider" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and its unveiling was reported in the 15:01:13 [[HoloNet News Core Edition]].<ref name="Insider" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marcluro-stone was mentioned in "[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:01:13]]," an [[in-universe]] news report written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 73|seventy-third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider" /> on [[December 26]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/12/news20031219.html|text=Mark Hamill On Stage In ''Insider'' #73}}</ref> "[[The Lost One]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref> that first aired on [[March 1]], [[2014]],<ref name="Air date">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fernsehserien.de/star-wars-the-clone-wars/episodenguide/staffel-6/9660|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Staffel 6 Episodenguide|work=[https://www.fernsehserien.de fernsehserien.de]|archivedate=20190419012747}}</ref> portrayed Valorum as alive<ref name="The Lost One" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile2014|60|20 BBY 67-70|Sifo-Dyas' Legacy}} places the events of "[[The Lost One]]" in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> contradicting his previously established death in 21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and leaving the [[canon]]icity of his marcluro-stone memorial within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity uncertain.<ref name="Date" />
